title: Gate list for a tabulated program
statement: Let $\kappa$ be finite, let $m,w,n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $F:\kappa\to\mathrm{List}(\mathrm{Bool})\to\mathrm{List}(\mathrm{Bool})$, and let $z$ be a Boolean list. For a program consisting of instructions $\mathrm{ins}_0,\ldots,\mathrm{ins}_{r-1}$, concatenate in order the gate lists for those instructions, using instruction index $i$ for $\mathrm{ins}_i$. The empty program produces the empty gate list.
hypotheses_covered: The program is a list of instructions over $\kappa$
